evidence: At baseline 952a618c LIB_DIR and NEW_KIND omit source talk. issue_body(..., 'talk', ...) therefore instructs lab.py new blog into library/ even though cmd_setup advertises source:talk and collect.py emits talk batches.
proposed_fix: Add talk -> library/talks/ and talk -> talk mappings; unit-test generated talk issue instructions.

evidence: At baseline 952a618c web maps to library/talks/ while NEW_KIND['web']='blog'. Web issue instructions therefore require a blog entry in the talks directory, conflicting with lab.py new blog output and PIPELINE.md.
proposed_fix: Map web to library/blogs/ and test the destination and new-kind agreement for every source.

evidence: None of these three mutation commands calls issue() or validates the active agent holder. cmd_release removes claimed unconditionally; cmd_done closes unconditionally. A different agent or stale owner can release/close another live claim. cmd_claim's replay also accepts any released by/done by comment without matching the winner.
proposed_fix: Centralize holder reconstruction and verify actor ownership before touch/release/done; ignore non-holder release/done comments in replay. Keep forced overrides explicit and auditable.

evidence: cmd_done checks only Path.exists() or git cat-file existence, then closes as completed. It never runs lab.py check or validates that supplied paths are library entries with the batch topic. Directories or unrelated files satisfy the local check despite PIPELINE.md's quality bar.
proposed_fix: Require regular library entry files, correct topic/type, and passing validation before closing; test directory/unrelated/invalid inputs. Do not alter existing entries.

evidence: cmd_publish reads ISSUES.tsv once, creates a remote issue, then appends the map after a second remote edit. Two worktrees with stale maps can both create the same batch issue, and a failure during the edit leaves an existing issue absent from the map.
proposed_fix: Before create, search remote open/closed issues for the deterministic batch marker; reconcile existing issue into the map. Add local atomic map updates and document residual cross-host race rather than claiming a local lock solves it.
